ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: Vault Dungeons
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Ash'karr campaign content for the six Forsaken vaults (VAULT_DUNGEON_BUILD_1, design/Jawa/worldbuilding/dungeons_arc_spec.md §3). Ships three parameterized KCSG StructureLayoutDef templates, one per vault type: RUT_VaultType1_MechanoidGarrison (Forgotten Arsenal held, doctrine turrets, materials/weapons-only core loot), RUT_VaultType2_FleshWeaponLoose (breached, bioweapon guardians, no direct loot), RUT_VaultType3_FrozenRakata (near-silent, a dormant sleeper at the core, wake/loot/leave mechanic not yet built). Each ring is authored per the owner-ruled concentric grammar (outer/garrison/core) and reachable only through its own ring, never skippable in a straight line. Not yet quicktest-proven (owed to the next bridge session) and not yet placed on any of the six real world tiles (owner hand-finish pass, held).
